newsitem.title: GERMANY: Britain's GDP growth to accelerate in 1997 -- Ifo.
newsitem.headline: Britain's GDP growth to accelerate in 1997 -- Ifo.

text.p: Britain's gross domestic product (GDP) will grow at an accelerated pace of about three percent in 1997 after 2.1 percent in 1996, Germany's Ifo economic research institute said.
But GDP growth will slow during the second half of 1997 and will be about 2.5 percent next year, Ifo said in a study due to be published on Monday.
The expansion will lead to a decline in the unemployment rate by about one percentage point to 6.5 percent in 1997. In 1998, the rate will slip to between five and 5.5 percent.
Consumer price inflation will be about three percent on average in 1997, rising to about 3.5 percent in 1998, Ifo said.

Britain fulfills most of the convergence criteria for European economic and monetary union (EMU) with the exception of the requirement for a stable exchange rate, Ifo said, noting that sterling had appreciated sharply.
